problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=-{7}^{x}+3?$

feedback.problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=-{6}^{x}-1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To plot the given function, we follow these steps:

- We take the curve $y={6}^{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13932041/assets/d96daead4646355f2cf0887afc9ddb9b51637d9c54f4f61870cc714ebd5992a0.png)

- Reflect it on the $x$-axis to give $y=-{6}^{x}.$ The $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(0,-1)$ but the horizontal asymptote stays at $y=0.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13932041/assets/3957fdd6a1ff8ece5a02eed85cc6f9941ef797ea8d6f2cedf2c322bd9393cdb1.png)

- Then, vertically shift it by $1$ unit down to give $y=-{6}^{x}-1.$ The point $(0,-1)$ moves to $(0,-2)$ and the horizontal asymptote moves from $y=0$ to $y=-1.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13932041/assets/8088ef67878739dc50544bfa9f1e21970a595c9e61bab4feb67de708b416378a.png)
